requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Early morning, and the cloud mist outside the mountain gate has not yet dispersed."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I brought three sacks, all the best from the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The ward cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before the words had fully left his mouth, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing burst into the hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back; the iron token at his waist was engraved: Chou Shuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feeding her one Spirit-Restoring Pill should be enough."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin wants you at the ward; Senior Brother Moqi and I will stay here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Alright. If Miss Qiu wakes up, come and get me at once."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xie Xuan stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin, I trust you are well. By order of the pavilion master, I have come to collect three parts in ten of the qi stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three tenths? The qi stones were saved up by our sect through hard work. When did an outsider ever get to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The ward has already cracked, and leaving the qi stones in your hands is not safe. I will come back in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xie Xuan sneered and turned to leave without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three days, he said, and it will be three days. He never breaks his word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me go and guard the ward. Yue Chuan is looking after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared."}, {"id": 1, "text": "At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the array-eye token. Guard it, and you have guarded your Dao."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yue Chuan pushed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother Wan. Miss Qiu has woken up; please pass on my thanks to her."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Good that you're awake. You were out cold for a whole day, so don't move around. ▼"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked toward the cracked sky beyond the window."}, {"id": 1, "text": "No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: Early morning, and the cloud mist outside the mountain gate has not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin wants you at the ward; Senior Brother Moqi and I will stay here.
translations.11: Alright. If Miss Qiu wakes up, come and get me at once.
translations.12: Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again.
translations.13: Xie Xuan stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, I trust you are well. By order of the pavilion master, I have come to collect three parts in ten of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three tenths? The qi stones were saved up by our sect through hard work. When did an outsider ever get to take them?
translations.16: The ward has already cracked, and leaving the qi stones in your hands is not safe. I will come back in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan sneered and turned to leave without looking back.
translations.18: Three days, he said, and it will be three days. He never breaks his word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go and guard the ward. Yue Chuan is looking after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the array-eye token. Guard it, and you have guarded your Dao.
translations.23: Yue Chuan pushed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wan. Miss Qiu has woken up; please pass on my thanks to her.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Good that you're awake. You were out cold for a whole day, so don't move around. ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked toward the cracked sky beyond the window.
translations.3: I brought three sacks, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before the words had fully left his mouth, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain
translations.7: Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing burst into the hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back; the iron token at his waist was engraved: Chou Shuang.
translations.9: It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feeding her one Spirit-Restoring Pill should be enough.
